description: Machine-readable instruction summary for one research data folder. Slice 1: minimal viable shape. The manifest is the single source of truth; DATA-DICTIONARY.md, README.md, and validation-report.md are rendered views of it (slices 3-5).

@context.description: JSON-LD context. Must map schema.org terms; may add a 'meemir' prefix for extension terms.

ambiguities.description: Open questions and known problems, stated plainly. First-class citizens, not footnotes. Renders to validation-report.md (slice 4).

resolution.description: How it was resolved, when known. Absent means still open.

citation.description: How to cite this dataset, one line.

fields.description: The data dictionary as structured data. One entry per field per file it appears in. Renders to DATA-DICTIONARY.md (slice 3).

description.description: What the field means, in plain language.

file.description: Path of the file this field appears in.

missingValues.description: Codes used for missing data, e.g. ["NA", "-999"].

name.description: Column/field name exactly as it appears in the file.

sameAs.description: Field name in another file measuring the same thing (cross-file linkage).

unit.description: Unit of measurement, e.g. ms, mm, NA if none.

files.description: Inventory of every file in the folder. The scanner (slice 2) fills sizeBytes, sha256, and tabular mechanically; a human (or agent) assigns role and description.

path.description: Path relative to the data folder root.

role.description: What the file is for. 'unknown' is honest; it becomes an ambiguity.

identifier.description: DOI, accession, or stable local identifier.

license.description: SPDX identifier or license name, e.g. CC-BY-4.0.

meemir.description: Meemir housekeeping; everything else stays in standard vocabularies.

generator.description: What produced this manifest: human, script name, or agent.

provenance.description: Where the data came from and what happened to it before this manifest.

title: Meemir data instruction manifest (v0.1)
